stdout:
Stacks
  astro-api                unproven
    A bun workspace with a Node HTTP API on Effect's HttpApi, a static Astro site with React islands and Tailwind, and a shared contract package holding the HttpApi definition, so islands call the API through a typed HttpApiClient; the API can also serve the built site.
  astro-blog               proven 2026-10-27
    A static Astro blog with MDX posts in a zod-validated content collection (draft/published/unlisted status), React islands, Tailwind with typography, sitemap and RSS, optional generated OG images, and vitest plus astro check.
  cloudflare-react-router  unproven
    Full-stack React Router on the local Workers runtime, typed bindings, JSON resource routes, a cron handler slot, Tailwind, Biome, and Workers integration tests.
  go-cli                   proven 2026-10-27
    A Go command-line tool with cobra commands, viper config (file, env, flags), structured errors with actionable suggestions, human and JSON output, testify tests with race detection and a coverage floor, and golangci-lint.
  mobile-expo              unproven
    Bun-workspace monorepo with an Expo Router app (NativeWind, TanStack Query), a Bun + Hono API (zod-openapi, Drizzle on Postgres), and a shared zod schemas package; the app reaches the API through a typed Hono client behind a hooks layer.
  python-react             proven 2026-10-27
    FastAPI backend (uv, ruff, mypy strict, pytest) plus a React single-page app (Vite, React Router in SPA mode, TanStack Query, Tailwind, shadcn/ui) that talks to the API through a typed client generated from its OpenAPI spec.
  react-router             unproven
    React Router framework mode with SSR, Effect services, typed HTTP errors, structured logs, Tailwind and shadcn, Vitest, and a health-route proving slice.
  tauri-react              unproven
    Tauri 2 desktop app with a Rust crate workspace behind a thin app shell, tauri-specta typed IPC, a React/Vite frontend that reaches Rust only through a transport facade with a mock for the browser and tests, Biome, Vitest, Playwright, clippy, and a crate-edge policy check.
  typescript-api           unproven
    A Node HTTP API on Effect's HttpApi, with schema-first REST resources, tagged errors mapped through one status table, structured request logs, a platform-free core that also runs as a web fetch handler, Vitest through real HTTP, and a health-route proving slice.
  typescript-cli           proven 2026-10-27
    A Bun-compiled TypeScript CLI with Effect commands and services, strict stdout/JSON contracts, lazy config, structured logs, Vitest, and compiled-binary tests.
